system.description:
The light you manifest begins to glitter as you bend it around an ally, guiding them to victory. As a bonus action, by spending 2 Stellar Charge you can select one allied creature within 60 feet of you. That ally can move up to their speed, and then can spend their Reaction to cast a Jutsu of their choice. If the jutsu forces a saving throw, on a failure against a hostile creature, on a failure the hostile creature becomes a Convergence for the next minute. If the jutsu does not force a saving throw but still affects a hostile creature, then the hostile creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they become a Convergence for the next minute.

Beginning at 7th level, the select ally creature can instead choose to spend 10 feet of their movement to teleport into a space closest to one of your Starlight’s. Beginning at 15th level, if you instead spend 3 Stellar Charges, to activate this Constellation it no longer costs a Bonus action, if you do, you cannot use this feature again the same turn.
